Method of Attack: Phishing campaign using pay raise bait to trick employees into handing out Microsoft Office 365 credentials
Phishing landing page mimicking Office 365 login page with email pre-filled and password requested
Email spoofing by manipulating 'from' field nickname to appear internal
Attack Vector: Phishing email with link to malicious Excel spreadsheet filename salary-increase-sheet-November-2019.xls
Redirect to phishing landing page at hxxps://salary365.web.app/#/auth-pass-form/
